summary: Gravel pull-off under trees by Ithaca Creek bush, homes about 35 m away.
reasons: Gravel pad clear of the lane

drivers.seclusion: Dense creek bush behind; nearest houses about 35 m, across the road or beyond the trees.
drivers.access_and_room: Bare gravel pad meets the road edge, two vehicles seen parked on it; room for one van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet suburban road beside a junction; the pad is set off the lane.
drivers.convention: Cars parked on the pad, likely walkers using the bush track; no campers seen.

flags: Pin lies in thick bush by Ithaca Creek, not on the pad
Creek 26 m from pin; ground steepens towards it
Pad is small and near a junction
sun_shade: Shaded by tall trees from the north and east; open to the south road side.

best_section.where: Gravel pad south of the pin, meeting the Fletcher Parade edge, with cars parked on it
